keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Eintracht Frankfurt 1, Hoffenheim 0. Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ansgar Knauff.
Penalty saved. Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) right footed shot saved in the bottom left corner by Noah Atubolu (Eintracht Frankfurt).
Penalty saved. Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) right footed shot saved in the bottom right corner by Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim).
Second Half begins Eintracht Frankfurt 1, Hoffenheim 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Noah Atubolu (Eintracht Frankfurt).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Adam Hlozek replaces Andrej Kramaric.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Adam Daghim replaces Tim Lemperle.
Substitution, Eintracht Frankfurt. Oscar Højlund replaces Noël Aséko.
Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Bambasé Conté replaces Fisnik Asllani.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Mats Rots replaces Bernardo.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Max Moerstedt replaces Alexander Prass.
Substitution, Eintracht Frankfurt. Nnamdi Collins replaces Ansgar Knauff.
Substitution, Eintracht Frankfurt. Mario Götze replaces Younes Ebnoutalib.
Substitution, Eintracht Frankfurt. Malik Pimpong replaces Jonathan Burkardt.
Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) is shown the yellow card.
Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) is shown the red card for violent conduct.
Noah Atubolu (Eintracht Frankfurt) is shown the yellow card.
Malik Pimpong (Eintracht Frankfurt) is shown the yellow card.
